resolved.title: SQL 约束
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]SQL Constraints[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

SQL [b]constraints [/b]are used to specify rules for table data.

[s0l0!-header][b]The following are commonly used SQL constraints:[/b][/s0l0!-header]
[b]NOT NULL[/b] - Indicates that a column cannot contain any NULL value.
[b]UNIQUE [/b]- Does not allow to insert a duplicate value in a column. The UNIQUE constraint maintains the uniqueness of a column in a table. More than one UNIQUE column can be used in a table.
[b]PRIMARY KEY[/b] - Enforces the table to accept unique data for a specific column and this constraint create a unique index for accessing the table faster.
[b]CHECK[/b] - Determines whether the value is valid or not from a logical expression.
[b]DEFAULT[/b] - While inserting data into a table, if no value is supplied to a column, then the column gets the value set as DEFAULT.

For example, the following means that the [b]name [/b]column disallows NULL values. [code format="sql" ]name varchar(100) [b]NOT NULL[/b][/code]
[note]During table creation, specify column level constraint(s) after the data type of that column.[/note]

content.text:
SQL**约束条件**用于指定表数据的规则。

以下是常用的**SQL约束**：

- **NOT NULL**: 表示一个列不能包含任何NULL值。
- **UNIQUE**: 不允许在一列中插入重复的值。UNIQUE约束保持了表内某一列的唯一性。一个表中可以使用一个以上的UNIQUE列。
- **PRIMARY KEY**:  强制要求表接受特定列的为主键，该约束创建了一个唯一的索引，以便更快地访问该表。
- **CHECK**: 从一个逻辑表达式中确定数值是否有效。
- **DEFAULT**: 在向表中插入数据时，如果没有向某一列提供值，那么该列的值将被设置为DEFAULT。

例如，下面的内容意味着**name**列不允许出现NULL值。

resolved.title: 自增 AUTO_INCREMENT
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]AUTO INCREMENT[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Auto-increment allows a unique number to be generated when a new record is inserted into a table.

Often, we would like the value of the primary key field to be created automatically every time a new record is inserted.

By default, the starting value for AUTO_INCREMENT is 1, and it will increment by 1 for each new record.
Let's set the UserID field to be a primary key that automatically generates a new value: [code format="sql" ]UserID int NOT NULL [b]AUTO_INCREMENT[/b],
PRIMARY KEY (UserID)[/code]
[note]Auto-increment allows a unique number to be generated when a new record is inserted into a table.[/note]

content.text:
**自增**允许在一个新的记录插入到表中时产生一个**唯一**的编码。

通常，我们希望每次插入新记录时，主键字段的值都能自动创建。

默认情况下，**AUTO_INCREMENT**的起始值是1，它将为每条新记录递增1。

让我们把**UserID**字段设定为自增的主键：
content.text_html:

通常，我们希望每次插入新记录时，主键字段的值都能自动创建。

默认情况下，AUTO_INCREMENT的起始值是1，它将为每条新记录递增1。 让我们把UserID字段设定为自动生成新值的主键。

resolved.title: 使用约束条件
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Using Constraints[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The example below demonstrates how to create a table using constraints. [code format="sql" ]CREATE TABLE Users (
id int [b]NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT[/b],
username varchar(40) [b]NOT NULL[/b], 
password varchar(10) [b]NOT NULL[/b],
[b]PRIMARY KEY(id)[/b]
);[/code]
The following SQL enforces that the "id", "username", and "password" columns do not accept NULL values. We also define the "id" column to be an auto-increment primary key field. 

[s0l0!-header][b]Here is the result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2851" width="100%"]
[note]When inserting a new record into the Users table, it's not necessary to specify a value for the id column; a unique new value will be added automatically.[/note]
